thread:
Ethan: Quick sync needed on regional opt-in plan for route-v2. Customers asking for predictable cutovers + clear rollback. Can we draft the full safety playbook here?
Lina: I sketched a regional phased schedule: EU-staging -> EU-prod 1% -> EU-prod 10% -> global 25% -> global 100%. Each step holds for 2h of steady-state telemetry before progressing.
Priya: For A/B we should do a holdback cohort (control) equal to 5% of each region for 48h to measure quality and session-level regressions. Shadow logs for an extra 24h after enabling to capture non-sampled signals.
Mark: Ops constraints: need to reserve 20% extra capacity on the EU cluster for the first two steps. Also pre-warm our prefix cache and warm the KV shards. I'll export the prewarm script in infra/playbooks.
Ethan: Telemetry gates proposal: evaluate in 15m windows at each step for short signal (errors, latency), and 2h windows for quality and token-cost trends. Immediate abort if 5xx rate delta > 0.4% absolute OR p95 latency increases by 25% vs baseline.
Lina: For model fallback, propose three-tier policy: (1) quick-variant: v2 -> v2-quant on memory pressure, (2) regional route fallback: region->v1 when region 5xx exceeds threshold, (3) tenant-level opt-out for flagged enterprise customers. We'll need per-tenant override flags.
Priya: A/B metrics: primary metric = session_success_rate on our benchmark set. Secondary: perplexity delta and manual spot-check rate. Acceptance criteria: primary metric drop <= 1.0% and no new critical hallucination patterns in sampled sessions.
Mark: Runbook snippet for emergency revert (also add to playbook):
```
# flip entire region off
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/v1/toggle -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"route_v2_region_enabled","region":"eu","value":false}'
# verify propagation
curl https://routing.internal/health?region=eu
```
deploy-bot: scheduled: routing-service:v2 canary -> start 2026-07-02T09:00Z (eu-staging), watch channel #eng-oncall.
Ethan: CI smoke test ask: add a test that synthetically generates 10% 5xx for 90s and asserts the route fallback triggers within 45s. This should be part of the gating pipeline for any rollout PR.
Lina: Communications plan: 72h notice to customers with impacted regions, include opt-out steps. For enterprise customers require a pre-cutover phone check if they had active incidents in last 30d.
Priya: Dashboard work: I'll create a funnel dashboard with per-region breakdowns: control vs treatment, error buckets, latency distribution, cost per 1k tokens. Link will be in the playbook.
Mark: Owner assignments: Lina = rollout schedule & comms, Priya = metrics & dashboards, Ethan = PM owner and rollback authority, Mark = infra & capacity.
Ethan: OK can we get a thumbs by EOD? If no objections I'll create the RFC and the release checklist. :white_check_mark:
